entries.name: Visual Decathlon (VD)
entries.task: Heterogeneous domain generalisation: train a feature extractor on six source datasets (CIFAR-100, Daimler Ped, GTSRB, Omniglot, SVHN, ImageNet) and evaluate off-the-shelf features with SVM or KNN on four held-out target datasets (Aircraft, D. Textures, VGG-Flowers, UCF101)

entries.name: Rotated MNIST
entries.task: Homogeneous domain generalisation: leave-one-domain-out digit classification across six rotated MNIST domains (M0, M15, M30, M45, M60, M75)

entries.name: PACS
entries.task: Homogeneous domain generalisation: object recognition across four domains (Photo, Art painting, Cartoon, Sketch) with 7 categories, using leave-one-domain-out evaluation
